description: This is the source code file `apply.c` from a Git-like version control system, containing functions for parsing, applying, and managing patches, including unified diffs, binary patches, and related operations.

classes.name: gitdiff_data
classes.description: Structure holding data related to git diff parsing, including root path, line number, and p-value.

classes.name: fragment
classes.description: Represents a hunka from a patch, with position, length, and patch text.

classes.name: line
classes.description: Represents a line in a file with length, hash, and flags.

classes.name: image
classes.description: Represents a file as an array of lines with associated buffers and line information.

classes.name: patch
classes.description: Structure representing a patch with details about filenames, modes, fragments, and status.

methods.name: void git_apply_config(void)
methods.description: Loads configuration options related to patch application.

methods.name: parse_whitespace_option
methods.description: Parses whitespace handling options for patch application.

methods.name: parse_ignorewhitespace_option
init_apply_state
methods.description: Initializes the apply_state struct with default values and configuration.

methods.name: void clear_apply_state(struct apply_state * state)
int check_apply_state(struct apply_state * state,int force_apply)
methods.description: Validates apply_state before applying patches, ensuring options are compatible.

methods.name: set_default_whitespace_mode
methods.description: Sets default whitespace handling based on current state.

methods.name: parse_git_diff_header
methods.description: Parses git diff headers into a patch structure.

methods.name: parse_chunk
methods.description: Parses a chunk of patch data and attaches parsed fragments to a patch.

methods.name: show_stats
methods.description: Displays statistics about a patch, such as filename and line changes.

methods.name: update_pre_post_images
methods.description: Updates the preimage and postimage buffers based on patch data.

methods.name: match_fragment
methods.description: Attempts to match a patch fragment against a file buffer, with whitespace and fuzz tolerance.

methods.name: int apply_all_patches(struct apply_state * state,int argc,const char ** argv,int options)
methods.description: Applies multiple patches to the repository or files based on provided arguments and options.

methods.name: int apply_parse_options(int argc,const char ** argv,struct apply_state * state,int * force_apply,int * options,const char * const * apply_usage)
methods.description: Parses command line options for the patch application process.
